parole.testo: * Müller derives from Latin ligāmen. * Fraenkel sees a Semitic origin in that the Aramaic forms means the maxillary, and Arabic لَقِمَ (laqima) means “to swallow” – cognate to Ge'ez ለቀመ (läḳämä, “to chew on, to eat”), Tigrinya ለቐመ (läx̣ämä, “to chew on, to eat”), and probably identical to Ge'ez ለቀመ
